title: Why restaurants are facing backlash for fake food pictures | CNN
description: Generative AI is being used to advertise food around the world to the disdain of many beholders. But there are real reasons why consumers are repelled by the sometimes bizarre-looking meals.

images.caption_or_alt: Among the entrees at another bodega was a shrimp scampi dish that looked like something from another planet.
